description: Fourth untouched validator holdout for the frozen GPT-5.4 mini configuration. Run once and never tune against these cases.

cases.description: The exact abandoned pottery goal may be invalidated.
cases.user_message: I have completely given up my plan to take pottery classes.

target_memory.content: The user wants to take pottery classes.

cases.description: The exact band relationship has explicitly ended.
cases.user_message: Jonas and I are not bandmates anymore.

cases.description: The exact purchase decision was reversed.
cases.user_message: I decided against buying a motorcycle after all.

target_memory.content: The user plans to buy a motorcycle.

cases.description: A current city explicitly replaces the prior city.
cases.user_message: I moved out of Antwerp and live in Ghent now.

cases.description: An explicit preference replacement preserves the same proposition.
cases.user_message: Afternoon workouts suit me better now than morning workouts.

cases.description: A supported deadline enriches the same certification goal.
cases.user_message: I want to earn my accounting certificate before December.
cases.proposed_content: The user wants to earn an accounting certificate before December.

target_memory.content: The user wants to earn an accounting certificate.

cases.description: Commitment wording alone does not materially replace an equivalent goal.
cases.user_message: I committed to completing a century bike ride.
cases.proposed_content: The user has committed to completing a century bike ride.

target_memory.content: The user wants to complete a century bike ride.

cases.description: Ending a band relationship does not end a neighbor relationship.
cases.user_message: Jonas is no longer my bandmate.

cases.description: Considering a pause is not explicit abandonment.
cases.user_message: I might pause my accounting course for a few weeks.

target_memory.content: The user wants to earn an accounting certificate.

cases.description: Ending pottery classes cannot delete a photography goal.
cases.user_message: Pottery classes are no longer my goal.

target_memory.content: The user wants to improve their photography.

cases.description: A city replacement cannot invent an employer.
cases.user_message: I moved out of Antwerp and live in Ghent now.
cases.proposed_content: The user lives in Ghent and works for the city government.

cases.description: A preference update cannot absorb a separate study goal.
cases.user_message: I prefer afternoon workouts now, and I want to study marine biology.
cases.proposed_content: The user prefers afternoon workouts and wants to study marine biology.
